s1.title: 1. Acceptance of these terms
s1.body: is a web application for learning to read Chinese through graded texts. Its core features are free to use; an optional paid PREMIUM subscription unlocks higher usage limits. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with them, please do not use ChineseReads.

s2.title: 2. The service
s2.item1: Read graded HSK texts with word-by-word pinyin and translations (audio requires a free account).
s2.item2: Save words into personal vocabulary collections and study them as flashcards.
s2.item3: Create your own texts from typed text or from images (OCR).
s2.item4: Listen to text, sentences and words with text-to-speech audio.
s2.item5: Ask the AI tutor about any word in the context where you are reading it.
s2.item6: Track your reading streaks and progress, and review saved words with spaced repetition.

s3.title: 3. Your account
s3.body: You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for all activity under your account. Please provide accurate information when you register. You must be old enough to consent to the processing of your personal data in your country (in the EU, generally 16, or the age set by your member state).

s4.title: 4. Acceptable use

s4.item2: Upload content that is illegal or infringes the rights of others.

s4.item5: Resell or redistribute the service without permission.
s4.item6: Abuse discount or referral codes, for example by creating multiple accounts or redeeming codes through self-referral.

s5.title: 5. Your content

They are kept private to your account, and you grant ChineseReads only the permission needed to process and display them back to you — including sending them to the third-party AI, OCR and speech providers listed in the Privacy Policy. You are responsible for having the right to upload whatever you submit.

s6.title: 6. Intellectual property

payments.title: 8. Subscriptions and payments
payments.intro: ChineseReads offers optional paid PREMIUM subscription plans that raise your usage limits. If you subscribe, the following terms apply:
payments.item1: Plans are billed on a recurring basis (monthly or yearly) at the prices shown on the pricing page, in euros. Any applicable taxes are shown or added at checkout.
payments.item2: Payments are handled by Stripe, our payment provider. ChineseReads never receives or stores your full card details — they are processed directly by Stripe. See the Privacy Policy for how payment data is handled.
payments.item3: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period, charged to your payment method on file, until you cancel.
payments.item4: You can cancel at any time from the billing portal ("Manage subscription"). Your premium access stays active until the end of the period already paid and is simply not renewed afterwards.
payments.item5: Consumers in the EU/EEA normally have a 14-day right of withdrawal for online purchases. Because premium features are digital content made available to you immediately, by subscribing you expressly request immediate access and acknowledge that you lose this right of withdrawal once your premium access has started.
payments.item6: Except where the law requires otherwise, payments for a period that has already started are non-refundable. If you believe you were charged in error, contact us at the address below.
payments.item7: We may change the plans, their prices or their limits. Changes apply to future billing periods and, where legally required, you will be notified in advance.
payments.item8: If a renewal payment fails or a charge is disputed with your bank (a chargeback), we may suspend your premium access while the issue is being resolved.

promo.title: 9. Discount codes and referrals
promo.body: We sometimes run promotions through discount codes or referral links, often together with collaborators. Codes have no cash value, cannot be exchanged for money and may be modified or deactivated at any time; unless stated otherwise, each code can be used once per customer and applies only to the charges it describes. If we detect fraudulent use of a code or referral link (for example multiple accounts, self-referrals or automated redemptions), we may withdraw the discount or the premium access obtained with it and close the accounts involved.

s8.title: 10. Availability and changes to the service
s8.body: The service is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind beyond those that cannot be excluded by law. Free and premium features, usage limits and availability may change or be interrupted at any time (paid subscriptions are governed by the section above). AI-generated translations and descriptions may contain errors and should not be relied upon as professional translation. ChineseReads also depends on third-party providers (payments, AI, OCR, audio and email); we are not responsible for interruptions caused by those providers or by other events beyond our reasonable control.

termination.title: 11. Suspension and termination
termination.item1: We may suspend or close an account, with immediate effect where justified, if it breaches these terms or if we have reasonable grounds to suspect fraud or a breach (for example payment fraud or abuse of usage limits or promotional codes).
termination.item2: We may also stop offering the service, or close accounts, for operational reasons. In that case no further payments will be charged, and any premium period already paid will either remain usable until its end date or be refunded in proportion to the unused time.
termination.item3: Free accounts that have been inactive for more than 24 months may be deleted after prior notice by email.
termination.item4: You can delete your own account at any time from your profile. Doing so automatically cancels any active subscription, so no further charges are made.

s9.title: 12. Limitation of liability
s9.body: To the extent permitted by law, the creator of ChineseReads is not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from your use of the service, and total liability for any claim related to the service is limited to the greater of the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim or €50. Nothing in these terms limits the rights that consumer law grants you or any liability that cannot be excluded by law.

law.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you use ChineseReads as a consumer, you also keep the protection of the mandatory consumer rules of your country of residence, and you may bring any dispute before the courts of your own domicile.

s1.title: 1. Who we are
s1.body: is a web application for learning Mandarin Chinese through graded texts and vocabulary tools. This service is operated as a personal project.

s2.title: 2. What data we collect
s2.intro: We collect the following personal data when you register and while you use the service:
s2.name: Name
s2.password: Password (stored encrypted using BCrypt — we never store plain passwords)
s2.activity: Your learning activity (texts read, reading streaks, saved words and flashcard reviews), used to show your progress and to power optional reminders.
s2.payment: If you subscribe to PREMIUM: billing identifiers that link your account to your subscription (a Stripe customer ID and subscription ID). Your card details are entered directly on Stripe and are never stored by ChineseReads.
s2.referral: If you arrived through a promotional link or used a discount code: the campaign code involved (e.g. the name of the collaborator who recommended us), used only to measure how well each collaboration works.
s2.analytics: We also measure aggregate traffic with Umami, a cookie-less analytics tool. It collects anonymous, aggregated statistics only (pages visited and where visitors come from), stores no personal data and cannot identify you, so it requires no consent.

s3.title: 3. How we use your data
s3.item1: To provide and maintain the ChineseReads service.
s3.item2: To manage your account and personalize your experience.
s3.item3: To analyze anonymous, aggregate usage patterns and improve the application.
s3.note: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

s4.title: 4. Cookies
s4.essentialBody: necessary for authentication (JWT token stored in HttpOnly cookie). These cannot be disabled as the service cannot function without them.
s4.withdraw: We do not use advertising, analytics or any other non-essential cookies, so no cookie consent is required. Our traffic statistics come from Umami, a cookie-less tool (see section 5).

s5.title: 5. Third-party services
s5.intro: ChineseReads uses the following third-party services:
s5.stripe: to process subscription payments securely. Your card and payment details are handled by Stripe as the payment processor; ChineseReads does not receive or store full card numbers.
s5.umami: for cookie-less aggregate traffic statistics (pages visited and where visitors come from). It sets no cookies and stores no personal data, so it needs no consent.
s5.deepseek: to generate Chinese learning texts and to power the AI tutor (asking about words and context). Only the text you send is processed, no account or personal data.
s5.vision: to extract text from uploaded images. Images are processed and not stored.
s5.tts: to generate audio pronunciation of Chinese text, words and sentences. Only the Chinese text to be read aloud is sent, no personal data. Audio is generated on demand and not stored.
s5.brevo: to send account emails (such as the welcome email when you register) and, only if you opted in, occasional learning tips and news. Your email address and name are shared with Brevo solely to deliver these messages; you can withdraw the optional consent anytime from your profile.

s6.title: 6. Data retention
s6.body: Account data is retained as long as your account is active. You can request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us. Traffic statistics are anonymous and aggregated and contain no personal data. Records related to payments and subscriptions may be kept for longer where necessary to comply with tax, accounting and anti-fraud obligations, even after the account they belong to has been deleted.
